item.title: Outside No 33 Agincourt Approx, 31st August
item.description:
Very large tree here. Crown reduction due. On your records reduction no is 444955. Honey Locust according to your records. Tree branches and very large seed pods scrape across tops of buses and high vehicles causing large noise problem. Concerned about size of tree being a cause of subsidence - I live at and own a flat at No 31 Agincourt near by. Tree is higher than surrounding houses by some distance. Falling Pods cause a huge mess annually.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Agincourt Road, Gospel Oak, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Blocked drain, 31st August
item.description:
I've been reporting this drain as blocked for months - finally on the 25th August you (the council) came to unblock the storm drains, I was told this drain isn't a storm drain but they would try and unblock anyway however, it would would be further unblocked on the same day because the "other drains" were scheduled to be unblocked on the same day (apparently 20 mins later). After the attempt to unblock the drain the photos are the result when it actually rained that night - the drain is completely unblocked - I have to jump over a massive deep puddle to get into my gate - unacceptable - please address this situation (as a side note, it too me 3 hours to clean and clear the mud and silt that was left all over my path, windows, gates etc post the storm drains being cleared - it was quite shocking).

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Gosshill Road, Bickley, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
